result:
**The plan:** Plan 92 audits the writing-skills skill against the repo's Claude Code guide. It aims to gather facts that are Claude Code-specific and version-dependent into one file, and to correct claims the guide doesn't support, such as an "always-loaded" listing and `@` links force-loading context. It also closes three backlog items, including the last stale drift entry.

**The build:** Micro-test rules and a kit were registered before any runs. RED control reps on the old layout tested whether authors put critical rules first. They found no failures, so no such instruction was added. The core edit followed. A new `references/claude-code.md` covers frontmatter keys, Haiku `model` caveats, when to fork and listing compaction. `SKILL.md` and `discovery.md` were corrected and now point to it. A clause on `model` under `context: fork` came next. Micro-tests on the new layout met every bar on Opus and Sonnet. Only the fork-reason prompt separated old from new, and read-before-edit remains untested. Last came updates to the conformance register, drift baseline and NOTICE, a 56-row guide review, and closing the plan.

**The project:** The skill gains a single, cited home for Claude Code runtime facts and loses several unsupported claims. One conformance gap is closed, a deviation is narrowed, and lint reports no stale files. The branch also commits test evidence and files five new backlog items. Before merge, one test output that names the owner should be redacted. Three review rows still need rulings.
